certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Geometry: Shapes, Area and Perimeter (Ages 8-10)

learning_outcomes.text: Classify 2D shapes by their sides and angles
Identify right angles and compare angles as larger or smaller
Recognise lines of symmetry in simple shapes
Measure and calculate the perimeter of rectilinear shapes
Find the area of rectangles by counting and by multiplying
Distinguish between perimeter and area in problems

integrative_case: Design a vegetable garden on squared paper: choose rectangular beds, work out the fencing needed around each bed using perimeter, and the soil needed to fill each bed using area, keeping within a set budget.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
